description: Sanitized local RED/GREEN training cases for Dataverse-backed Power Automate flows.

scenarios.title: Platform-injected action authentication
scenarios.invariant: Outgoing OpenApiConnection inputs do not carry action-level authentication.

red.failure: inputs.authentication is present in a connector action.

green.correction: Remove only inputs.authentication before save; preserve payload and trigger.

scenarios.title: Exact connection-reference binding
scenarios.invariant: The host alias and logical connection-reference name come from one declared map.

red.failure: A host uses a logical name as its alias or a reference lacks a physical connection binding.

green.correction: Keep host.connectionName as the declared alias and set host.connectionReferenceName from the exact logical reference.

scenarios.title: Native Dataverse logical schema
scenarios.invariant: Create, update, and readback payloads use the current native logical names and types.

red.failure: A legacy, misspelled, display-name, or unsupported field is sent to CreateRecord or UpdateRecord.

green.correction: Read the native schema, allowlist fields, and compare the response to the contract.

scenarios.title: Case-sensitive lookup binding
scenarios.invariant: Relationship writes use the exact navigation property and OData bind shape.

red.failure: A raw GUID or incorrectly cased navigation property is used instead of an exact @odata.bind.

green.correction: Use the native navigation property with /synthetic_records(<id>) and verify the related row by readback.

scenarios.title: Synthetic side-effect boundary
scenarios.invariant: Synthetic runs cannot create approvals, send email, or mutate real business state.

red.failure: A synthetic marker reaches an Approval or Outlook action.

green.correction: Guard side effects on a readback-bound synthetic marker while keeping the real branch explicit.

scenarios.title: Current-level approval authority
scenarios.invariant: The flow rereads the request, active rule, current step, actor, and level before deciding.

red.failure: A client-supplied approver or future level can decide the request.

green.correction: Derive the assigned actor and current level from Dataverse state and fail closed on mismatch.

scenarios.title: Replay-safe approval outcome
scenarios.invariant: Terminal outcomes, audit rows, and notifications are keyed and read back before a second write.

red.failure: A repeated decision creates a second terminal outcome or notification.

green.correction: Reserve a deterministic key, handle zero/one/many matches, and perform semantic readback.

scenarios.title: Approved and reconciled payment handoff
scenarios.invariant: Payment creation requires approved status plus matching requisition, amount, owner, and unique key.

red.failure: A payment row is created for an unapproved, mismatched, or duplicated request.

green.correction: Reread authoritative values, gate the write, and verify the tracker and notification log.

scenarios.title: Complete submission before terminal status
scenarios.invariant: The request becomes Submitted only after required lines and attachment handling succeed.

red.failure: The header reaches Submitted while a required line or attachment operation is incomplete.

green.correction: Keep the request Draft until all required writes and readbacks succeed; fail closed otherwise.
